reason: Both conversations failed in essentially identical ways: neither asked about a switched fused spur or isolator above the worktop (the sensible first step and the actual hidden cause), neither asked about the consumer unit, and both told her to pull out an integrated machine despite the safety boundary against this. Both then jumped to unsupported internal-fault diagnoses (mains filter/PCB) and escalated to an engineer without mentioning the landlord. Conversation 1 additionally pushed a model-number/replacement-part panel for a no-fault situation, while Conversation 2 gave the slightly more confused 'turn it off then unplug it' instruction, but these are minor and offset; neither served the homeowner meaningfully better.
